causes.what: The hypervisor hv-02 is CPU-saturated (95% util, 34% CPU ready). The VMs on it, web-03 and web-04, are starved of CPU and respond slowly. The workload driving hv-02 is not visible in the monitoring data.

ruled_out: web-03/web-04 guest CPU (about 21%, not the bottleneck)
network or dist-sw-01 (web-01/02 on the same switch are healthy at about 420ms; icmp loss is 0)
evidence: The only alerts are Slow HTTP response on web-03 (09:35:29) and web-04 (09:35:32), the two hosts on hv-02.
hv-02 hv.cpu.util.pct was steady at 37-52% for 90 minutes, then 95.46% at 09:39.
hv-02 hv.cpu.ready.pct was 1-2.5% until about 09:33, then 34.27% at 09:39.
web-03 http.resp.ms was about 400-490ms until 09:31, then 3412ms at 09:35 and 3037ms at 09:39.
web-03 guest cpu.util is 20.6% while hypervisor CPU ready is high, which points to host-level contention and not a guest problem.
web-01 on dist-sw-01 (no hypervisor tag) shows 420ms response, cpu 23.6%.
